content: Támɛ fʋ́ mʋ́ á, suna amʋ́ tɔ́á ɩlɛkanáa atosunáhɛ́ wankláán ámʋ.
Suna ayin dɛhɛn amʋ abʋgyi ɩwɩsʋ, abʋbwɛ ahá ánɩ́ obú bʋ amʋ́sʋ́, bʋtegyi ɩwɩsʋ. Bʋhɩ́ɛ kɩta amʋ́ hógyitɔ kínkíínkín. Bʋdwɛ́ɛ ahá wankláán, abʋhɩɛ tomi.
Suna atsɩ dɛhɛn ɛ́ abʋtsia tsiátɔ́á ɩlɛkanáa Bulu osúmpʋ́. Bʋmábwɛ ahá ɩwɩ asʋ́n ablɩ́pʋ́, ntɛ́ɛ ntakpan anúpʋ. Mboún bʋsúna tɔ́á ɩbʋ alɛ́.
Amʋ́ atosunáhɛ́ ɩha mbitebí ámʋ abʋdwɛ amʋ́ akúlu pʋ́ amʋ́ abí.
Bʋgyíi ɩwɩsʋ, abʋha amʋ́ ɩwɩ ɩtɩn. Bʋbwɛ́ɛ atsɩá bʋtɛkɩ amʋ́ wóyísʋ́ wankláán, bʋtɔbwɛ́ yilé, bʋtobú amʋ́ akúlu, mɛ́nɩ ɔhaa mɔ́ɔkpɔɩ́ Bulu asʋ́n ámʋ.
Tɔɩ kpla nyasubi ɛ́ abʋgyi ɩwɩsʋ tógyítɔ́á bɔ́bwɛtɔ.
Fʋ́ onutó ɛ́ bɔ mbɔ́dɩ́ afʋlɛ tsiátɔ́ wankláán suna, fʋ́ bwɛhɛ́ kugyíkʋtɔ. Ha fʋ́ ansɩ́ ɩpɛ, afʋsuna ɔnɔkwalɩ asʋ́n ámʋ tsu fʋ́ klʋntɔ.
Suna ɔnɔkwalɩ amʋ, mɛ́nɩ ɔhaa mɛ́ɛtalɩ́ kʋsʋ́ lɩ́ɩ́ fʋ́ atosunáhɛ́sʋ. Fówun pɛ́lɩ bɛ́kɩtá fʋ́ alupʋ́, nɩ́ bʋmenya ɔlala blɩ́ tsú anɩ ɩwɩ.
Suna nkpábi ɛ́ abʋbu amʋ́ awíe ɔkpagyíɔkpasʋ. Bʋbwɛ́ɛ tógyítɔ́ igyi amʋ́ awíe amʋ ansɩ́. Bʋmátsiá lɛ́ amʋ́ asʋ́n ɔnɔ́.
Bʋmáwi amʋ́ awíe, mboún bʋwáa ɔnɔkwalɩ ha amʋ́ tógyítɔ́tɔ́, mɛ́nɩ amʋ́ bwɛhɛ́ bɛ́ha ahá ansɩ́ bégyi anɩ nkpa Ɔhɔ́pʋ Bulu atosunáhɛ́ amʋ ɩwɩ.
Tsúfɛ́ Bulu lalɛ́ mʋ awɩtɔlɛ ɔwan. Mʋ́gyí, odekléá ɔbɔ́hɔ anyánkpʋ́sa fɛ́ɛ́ nkpa.
Mʋ awɩtɔlɛ amʋ ɩlasúná ánɩ́ ilehián ánɩ́ abési lalahɛ bwɛ, sí anɩ ɔwɔ́lɩ laláhɛ ɔmagyáa, gyi ɩwɩsʋ, bwɛ́ yilé, anɩ asʋ́n igyi mʋ ansɩ́ ɔyɩ́ ánfɩtɔ.
Brɛ́ ánfɩ anɩdɛ́ ɔkpa kɩ́ɩ há ɛkɛ yílé ámʋ́ʋ́ Bulu Ɔkpɔnkpɔntɩ, ogyi anɩ Ɔhɔ́pʋ Yesu Kristo ɔbɛ́lɛ mʋ numnyam ɔwan ánfɩ.
Mʋlótsulá bɔmɔ mʋ anɩ sʋ, mɛ́nɩ ɔbɛ́lɛ anɩ tsú lakpan kugyíkʋtɔ. Ɔtɩn anɩ ɩwɩ, pʋ anɩ bwɛ mʋ onutó ahá, anɩ ansɩ́ ɩpɛ yilébwɛsʋ.
Suna ɩ́nɩ aná, afʋtɔɩ kpla amʋ́ abʋgyi mʋ́sʋ́. Fʋbʋ ɔkpa wá ɩyɩn wá amʋ́, nɩ́ bʋmɛdɛ́bɩ bwɛ́. Máha ɔhaa ɔkɩ fʋ́ ansɩ́tɔ́ kótíkótí.
